visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female server in a black chef's uniform and a white surgical mask carries a wooden tray with two large bowls of steaming noodles. The setting is a clean, bright restaurant kitchen with white tiles and stainless steel fixtures. The camera quickly cuts to a metal noodle strainer being lifted out of boiling water, followed by wide noodles being poured into a black ceramic bowl. (2) Close-up shots show the assembly of braised pork noodles: pieces of dark, tender pork and green bok choy are ladled in, followed by a rich, dark brown broth. Chopsticks lift a glistening piece of pork and a bunch of thick, wavy ramen noodles to emphasize their texture and elasticity. A pair of hands in purple gloves places small dishes of chili sauce and pickled vegetables next to the bowl. (3) The focus shifts to a second dish as a golden-yellow soup is poured over pork slices, green vegetables, and crispy fried dough sticks. A spoon lifts a piece of the dough stick, which is visibly saturated with the yellow broth. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the steam rising from the fresh meal. (4) For the third dish, dark peppercorn sauce is drizzled over thin white noodles in a large pot and tossed thoroughly. The seasoned noodles are then plated and topped with a soft-boiled egg and crispy slices of red-yeast pork cutlet. The camera zooms in on the thin noodles being lifted with chopsticks, showing the oily coating and spices. (5) A final montage features a bowl of rice topped with stir-fried pork strips, scallions, and a fried egg, along with various small side dishes like sliced pig ears. The video ends with a wide shot of the restaurant's interior, showing green chairs, wooden tables, and the '豚沐麵' logo on the back wall as diners eat in the background.
